description:
Following the terrorist attack on the Ark, Mihara's memory was erased once again.
Through Mana, she received a new body that Syuen had prepared beforehand.
She has returned to the surface, searching for rare Rapture species.

lines.text:
I think these changes in my body have made me more sensitive.
Now I can enjoy even deeper sensations.
So this is what it feels like to be shackled?
With this body, I think I'll be able to try out even more things, haha.

The pain whenever I see Yuni is immense...
It's something I'll never forget.
There's no greater thrill than when your life is on the line!
To have a relationship where we inflict and endure pain together... wouldn't that be perfect?

I can't afford to be alone like this.
I'm sorry, but can I go to Yuni?

It's okay, I can wait for a bit.
Anxiety can be exciting for me, too.
"Seedy Club?" A rather unusual name... but I like it.
That's strange. I don't remember ever having been here, but this place feels so familiar somehow.
Do you think Yuni and I will fit in here? It's such a bright and lively place.
Living life on the edge, with a bomb strapped to your back. What could be more thrilling than that?

I feel like my skin is thinner than before.
That must mean I'll be able to feel more, right?
I need to keep myself healthy, so that I can protect Yuni.

Hmm, this feels nice.
Such sensations feel pretty good too.
Haha. Yuni would get a kick out of this.
This is my first time seeing this, but it feels familiar. I'll make good use of this.

How should I repay you?
I wonder if you and I have similar tastes? Haha.

This feeling, this sensation... I've felt it before. 
Would you show me a little more?
You really do understand. I like that.
Is this what it means when they say existence itself is stimulating?
Shall we go, Yuni?
Could you press a little harder?
Keep showing us the way!
Enough business. Time for pleasure.
This is going to be fun.
Push me to my limit.
I'm not sure if I can hit hard enough...
I'm getting more and more excited!
Just a second, Yuni.
I just got hit. It felt good.
I can't hold back...
Quietly, fully, restrain me.
Let's all enjoy this together.
This isn't bad either.
So weak.
I'm pretty good too, aren't I?
Urgh...!
Right there!
Ahh...!
I'm sorry, Yuni. I must have enjoyed it too much.
It's already over? That's a shame. It felt good. Haha.

Still too weak.
Can't you do it a little harder?
When are you finally going to let go of your reservations and let me enjoy this fully?
If you're under some stress, feel free to take it out on me, hehe.

I think I've become accustomed to these things... 
Unless it's a stronger stimulus, my body won't even react anymore.

My body has become quite sensitive.
Please, keep going.

I've never met someone I could speak with so easily.
Let's talk all night! Hehe!

You're not going to leave me like this, are you?
My body is getting restless...

The way you're looking at me, it's like you want to devour me.
If you're going to make a move, take it slow and savor every moment. Hehe.
I'll be waiting for you tonight, hehe.

Isn't there somewhere darker or quieter we can go?
It's too bright here.
I don't see anyone here worth conversing with.

You know the rules. 
Answer me with your actions.
Now that you've become stronger, go harder.
Your stamina has improved, so now we can last longer.
There's no time to rest. Let's keep going.

This doesn't seem like a gift just for me.
Hehe, we can both put it to good use later.
Oh, so this is what you're into? I'll keep that in mind.
Since I received a gift, I'll have to put in more effort today. Hehe.
You've managed to make me a very eager girl. I'm impressed.
I want to have even more conversations with you.
Oh dear, it looks like you've captured both my body and mind, hehe.
All right, let's go.
Mmh, right there, that's good.
Be rough with me.
Hehe. What kind of thrill will you give me?
Let me tease you.
I'm right here, try and hit me!
Just don't finish too quickly.
It was just starting to get good.
We can't let our conversations get interrupted.
Hehe. Ahaha!
I can feel it.
Harder... Just a bit harder...!
Swing wildly!
Maybe that was too intense.
It's over already?
Is this one next?
Urgh...!
A little more!
Ahah...!
Hehe... I'm out of breath. I can't go on.
Hmm, not quite enough. Why don't we continue for a little while longer? Hehe.
